text_block_list.text:
Race by race, Wonder Acute stacked up her 
achievements, and then—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we sure ran a whole lot. Thanks 
to you~

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I think I've gained a decent amount of 
strength~. Wonder if I've at least become 
half-competent now."

Thanks in part to rigorously working 
through basic training, her running has 
improved considerably.

If I keep getting stronger at this rate, 
by summer—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"So, Trainer-san. What's our next 
goal...?"

I was so happy. That the day had finally 
come when I could say those words out 
loud.
choice_data_list: Let's go with the "Japan Dirt Derby"!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"The Japan Dirt Derby"...! Well now, color 
me surprised...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A Classic-class Dirt GⅠ you can only run 
once in a lifetime... And I'm gonna enter?
choice_data_list: Yeah, we can aim for it now!
Yeah, we can aim for it now!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh... Thank you. Thank you so much, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Then, will you take my hand and lead the 
way there once more?

Even if we make it there, the opponents 
will be vastly stronger than anything 
we've faced before.

It was clear that unless she trained 
harder than ever before, she wouldn't even 
stand a chance.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well then, in preparation for the Japan 
Dirt Derby, let's begin today's 
training...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... hafuu...

Something seemed a little off about her. 
Even though we hadn't even started 
warm-ups yet today...

She looks somewhat exhausted. Her 
movements are a bit stiff as well.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Oh dear, a bit out of breath, are we...? 
Don't worry, I'm fine."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There are days like this too. Somehow, 
while running...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huh, just for today?
choice_data_list:
Is getting out of breath only happening 
today?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Umm... Well, that's... It feels like it's 
been happening occasionally lately...?

Judging by his tone of voice... it didn't 
seem like a problem limited to just today.
(Rumble rumble rumble...)

I had... a bad premonition. Wonder Acute 
had embraced my self-styled, grueling 
training...

Or perhaps, the toll is finally starting 
to show. Up until now, she's managed to 
pull through with sheer tenacity, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I wonder why. I go to bed early 
and wake up early, and I'm eating right, 
but..."
choice_data_list:
Do you use a recommended meal management 
app?

text_block_list.text:
A while back, I recommended a meal 
management app for Umamusume to Wonder 
Acute.

If I base it on that, the nutritional 
balance shouldn't be a problem, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ah, that... yeah, that.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... It really is lovely. Thank you so 
much for recommending it to me...

...It seems she is using it. If it's not a 
nutritional issue either...

The only conceivable reason would be 
overworking after all...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Umm, Trainer-san? Are we not going to 
practice today~?
choice_data_list: I do. I want to, but...

text_block_list.text:
I can't organize my thoughts. Is it really 
okay to keep training at our current pace?

"I couldn't feel confident about whether 
it was truly right to push forward toward 
the Japan Dirt Derby."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

Because it's my own unique style, there 
are no colleagues I can turn to for 
advice. The one to make the call 
is—myself.

Yet there isn't a single clue. I don't 
know what to do at all...
What troubles you, young Trainer!?

Do not fret, press forward! I know not the 
circumstances, but simply forge ahead!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oho? And you are...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Yes, I am! I am truly the one!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A passing conqueror! Known to all as T.M. 
Opera O!!

"T.M. Opera O." An opera singer-like 
narcissist who might look like a gag 
Umamusume at first glance, but—

She's a powerhouse with seven GⅠ victories 
under her belt. Known for her fearsome 
audacity—

No matter how close the contest, never 
yielding before the finish line— truly a 
champion among champions.
Why would that T.M. Opera O be here...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to introduce myself, is all. 
Later!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

To make an entrance that over-the-top, 
only to claim you're 'just passing by,' is 
a bit much.

A few days later—I decided to seek advice 
from the Seven-Crown Umamusume once again.
